name: Uruleyes
subtitle: Natural-language search for Uruguayan law
text: A natural-language search engine for Uruguayan law. It indexes legislation and official sources (IMPO, Parliament, MTSS, BPS and more), classifies results by legal practice area, and was load-tested at 1,500 searches a minute with a 46 ms p95 on a 4-core server. Adopted widely by Uruguay's legal community.

screenshots.alt: Uruleyes search results for “despido por embarazo”: 58 laws and decrees, each tagged by practice area with a link to the official text in IMPO.
